proposals.title: Cross-chain signal: enforce per-chain cost floor before any positive-edge call
proposals.rationale: cross_chain_strategy_signals.py computes net_edge_bps as gross_edge_bps minus sum of cost fields but the caller in shadow_strategy_executor can receive a MarketFeatures object whose cost fields (fees_bps, slippage_bps, price_impact_bps, latency_reserve_bps) are all zero if a chain adapter has not yet populated them. A zero-cost phantom edge passes the positive-edge gate and risks shadow trades on unpriced opportunities. A hard minimum cost floor per chain (e.g. 10 bps EVM, 5 bps Solana) should be enforced inside the signal computation rather than relying on adapter completeness.

evidence.observation: net_edge_bps is computed from fields that default to Decimal('0') if not populated; no minimum cost floor is applied
MarketFeatures dataclass allows all cost fields to be zero; no guard in proposal validation

proposals.shadow_test: Inject a MarketFeatures with gross_edge_bps=50, all cost fields=0 for both SOLANA and EVM chain types. Assert that positive_edge() returns False (or raises) when a minimum-cost-floor guard is in place. Also inject a correctly costed feature set and assert the signal remains True.
proposals.net_pl_impact: Prevents phantom edge from masking unpriced opportunities in shadow mode; does not reduce opportunity count for properly costed signals.

proposals.title: Strategy Lab: log and surface participation rate when eligible_opportunities > MIN but participation < MIN_ELIGIBLE_PARTICIPATION
proposals.rationale: evaluate_strategy() in strategy_lab.py correctly flags REWORK when profit_factor < MIN_PROFIT_FACTOR but does not produce a structured log or metric when a strategy's participation rate is below MIN_ELIGIBLE_PARTICIPATION (0.20). Operators and the hourly review loop cannot distinguish a strategy that sees many eligible opportunities and ignores them from one that simply sees none. Adding a structured participation_rate metric and a WARNING log when participation is low but opportunities are present will enable targeted filter rework recommendations.

evidence.observation: MIN_ELIGIBLE_PARTICIPATION is defined but strategy_metrics() does not return a participation_rate field; evaluate_strategy() does not emit a distinct warning for low-participation cases

proposals.shadow_test: Create a strategy_lab_windows record set with eligible_opportunities=20 and participated=1 (5 pct). Call evaluate_strategy() and assert the returned dict contains participation_rate=Decimal('0.05') and a status/warning indicating low-participation. Verify that a second set with participated=5 (25 pct) does not trigger the warning.
proposals.net_pl_impact: No direct P&L change; enables diagnostic visibility that prevents profitable opportunities from being silently suppressed by over-restrictive filters.

proposals.title: Research: add calibration check (Brier score) to forecast_positive_edge_probability field before trusting it for participation
proposals.rationale: MarketFeatures.forecast_positive_edge_probability is used as an input to positive_edge decisions in cross_chain_strategy_signals.py but there is no calibration metric (e.g. Brier score or log loss) recorded alongside it. An uncalibrated forecast with high stated probability can inflate participation in low-edge periods. The FORECAST_RESEARCH_SPEC in strategy_lab_research.py defines the correct approach but does not yet enforce calibration evidence before a forecast field is trusted. Recommended next step: collect shadow outcomes against forecast probabilities and compute rolling Brier score before enabling forecast gating in live evaluation.

evidence.observation: forecast_positive_edge_probability is consumed directly without a calibration guard
FORECAST_RESEARCH_SPEC defines calibration requirement (Brier/log loss) but no enforcement mechanism exists in the evaluation path

proposals.shadow_test: After at least 50 shadow outcomes are available per chain, compute rolling Brier score for forecast_positive_edge_probability. Assert Brier score < 0.25 before any strategy is allowed to use forecast gating. Document chain-specific and market-regime-separated results.
proposals.research_plan: 1. Collect shadow execution outcomes with recorded forecast probabilities for both Solana and EVM chains over >= 50 events per chain. 2. Compute rolling Brier score and compare to naive baseline (always predict 0.5). 3. If Brier score < 0.25 AND positive net P&L in shadow, proceed to IMPROVE proposal for calibration-gated forecasting.
proposals.net_pl_impact: Cannot be quantified without calibration data; reduces risk of phantom-edge trades driven by an uncalibrated model.
